subheading: Compliance and regulatory intel from BIS, industry bodies, and the press.

i1.headline: BIS launches revised licensing portal for manufacturers
i1.summary: The new e-BIS portal cuts average licence-application processing time and adds real-time status tracking.

i2.headline: Hallmarking compliance push sees 18% jump in registered jewellers
i2.summary: Enforcement drives across three states pushed more jewellers into the mandatory hallmarking scheme this quarter.

i3.headline: India, EU discuss mutual recognition for electronics safety certification
i3.summary: Early-stage talks could let electronics certified under EU schemes fast-track BIS conformity assessment.

i4.headline: Draft amendment to toy safety standard opens for consultation
i4.summary: Stakeholders have until the end of the month to comment on proposed changes to mechanical safety clauses.

i5.headline: Appliance makers flag supply delays ahead of certification deadline
i5.summary: Industry associations warn that lab testing backlogs could push some manufacturers past the compliance window.

i6.headline: BIS expands Quality Control Order list to 12 new categories
i6.summary: The expanded QCO list brings additional electronics and household product categories under mandatory certification.

i7.headline: Industry body seeks simplified certification pathway for MSMEs
i7.summary: A proposal to reduce paperwork and fees for small manufacturers is under review by the standing committee.

i8.headline: New pressure cooker safety standard cuts testing turnaround
i8.summary: Revised test protocols under IS 2347 are reported to shorten typical lab turnaround by several weeks.

i9.headline: ISO revises household appliance safety benchmark
i9.summary: BIS says it will review alignment between the revised ISO benchmark and existing Indian Standards.

i10.headline: Toy exporters welcome faster BIS approval timelines
i10.summary: Exporters report shorter wait times for certification renewals following recent process changes.
